cn_steps: 启用 `Remote Database Support`（模块 `RemoteDatabaseSupport`）。
它提供远程数据库支持（把引擎侧数据接到远程 DB）。
在需要远程查询/写入数据库的工具或运行时流程里依赖该模块。
按项目自行配置连接与凭据；不要把密钥打进 Shipping 包。
en_steps: Enable `Remote Database Support` (module `RemoteDatabaseSupport`).
It provides remote-database support (engine-side access to a remote DB).
Depend on this module in tools or runtime flows that need remote query/write.
Configure connection and credentials per project; do not bake secrets into a shipping build.
note_cn: 引擎侧的远程数据库访问支持。

cn_steps: 启用 `Remote Procedure Calls Base`（模块 `RPCBase`）。
它是客户端应用可用来实现 RPC 库的基础框架。
在自研 RPC 库时依赖 `RPCBase`，而不是从零搭调用约定。
属基础框架；上层协议/传输由应用自己接。
en_steps: Enable `Remote Procedure Calls Base` (module `RPCBase`).
It is an RPC base framework that client applications can use to implement RPC libraries.
Depend on `RPCBase` when building your own RPC library instead of inventing the call convention from scratch.
It is a foundation framework; the app supplies the upper protocol/transport.
note_cn: 供客户端实现 RPC 库的基础框架。
note_en: Base RPC framework for client apps to implement RPC libraries.

cn_steps: 启用 `RemoteSession`（运行时 `RemoteSession`，编辑器 `RemoteSessionEditor`）。
它让一个引擎实例充当第二个实例的瘦客户端（渲染画面 + 回传输入）。
一台跑完整游戏，另一台只显示/操作，用于远程预览或设备协同。
属实验性远程会话；接口可能随版本变化。
en_steps: Enable `RemoteSession` (runtime `RemoteSession`, editor `RemoteSessionEditor`).
It lets one engine instance act as a thin client (rendering and input) to a second instance.
Run the full game on one machine and display/control from another for remote preview or device pairing.
It is an experimental remote-session plugin; the contract may change across versions.
note_cn: 一个实例当瘦客户端，显示并操作另一个实例。
note_en: One instance as a thin client (video + input) to another.

cn_steps: 启用 `Render Grid`（模块 `RenderGrid`、`RenderGridDeveloper`、`RenderGridEditor`）。
它是创建渲染过场动画的高级管线（批量/网格化渲染任务）。
用 Render Grid 组织多镜头/多变体渲染作业，而不是逐条手点 MRQ。
Game 模块依赖运行时；编辑器/开发者模块只进对应 Target。
en_steps: Enable `Render Grid` (modules `RenderGrid`, `RenderGridDeveloper`, `RenderGridEditor`).
It is an advanced pipeline for creating rendered cinematics (batched/grid render jobs).
Organize multi-shot/multi-variant render jobs in Render Grid instead of firing MRQ one by one.
Game modules depend on runtime; editor/developer modules go to matching targets only.
note_cn: 批量/网格化渲染过场动画的高级管线。
note_en: Advanced pipeline for batched/grid cinematic renders.

cn_steps: 启用 `Render Trace`（模块 `RenderTrace`）。
它提供对网格上物理材质的像素级采样（按屏幕像素打到物理材质）。
用于需要精确采样物理表面（轮胎、足迹、弹着点）的玩法。
属运行时采样；可进游戏包。
en_steps: Enable `Render Trace` (module `RenderTrace`).
It provides pixel-perfect sampling of physical materials on meshes.
Use it for gameplay that must sample physical surfaces precisely (tires, footprints, impact points).
It is runtime sampling; can ship in a cooked game.
note_cn: 对网格物理材质做像素级采样。
note_en: Pixel-perfect sampling of physical materials on meshes.

cn_steps: 启用 `RenderDoc Plugin`（模块 `RenderDocPlugin`）。
它把 RenderDoc 图形调试器/分析器接到引擎。
在编辑器里一键捕捉帧，用 RenderDoc 查 draw call 与资源。
属编辑器/开发者插件；默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `RenderDoc Plugin` (module `RenderDocPlugin`).
It integrates the RenderDoc graphics debugger/profiler with the engine.
Capture a frame from the editor, then inspect draw calls and resources in RenderDoc.
It is an editor/developer plugin; it does not ship by default.
note_cn: 引擎与 RenderDoc 图形调试器的集成。
note_en: Engine integration with the RenderDoc graphics debugger.

cn_steps: 启用 `RenderTrace Insights`（模块 `RenderTraceInsights`）。
它在 Unreal Insights 里提供渲染调试设施。
开 Insights 采集后查看渲染相关 Trace，配合 Render Trace 分析。
属 Insights/Trace 可视化；开发机使用。
en_steps: Enable `RenderTrace Insights` (module `RenderTraceInsights`).
It provides rendering debug facilities in Unreal Insights.
Capture in Insights, then inspect render-related traces (pairs with Render Trace).
It is Insights/Trace visualization; used on dev machines.
note_cn: Unreal Insights 中的渲染调试设施。
note_en: Rendering debug facilities in Unreal Insights.

cn_steps: 启用 `Replay Tracks (Experimental)`（运行时 `ReplayTracks`，编辑器 `ReplayTracksEditor`）。
它提供用于播放已录制玩法的 Sequencer 轨道。
把 Replay 轨加到 Level Sequence，在过场里回放录制的游戏。
属实验性 Sequencer 扩展；接口可能随版本变化。
en_steps: Enable `Replay Tracks (Experimental)` (runtime `ReplayTracks`, editor `ReplayTracksEditor`).
It provides Sequencer tracks for playing recorded gameplay.
Add Replay tracks to a Level Sequence to play back recorded gameplay in a cinematic.
It is an experimental Sequencer extension; the contract may change across versions.
note_cn: 在 Sequencer 里播放已录制玩法的轨道。
note_en: Sequencer tracks for playing recorded gameplay.

cn_steps: 启用 `ReplayKit for iOS`（模块 `IOSReplayKit`）。
它支持用 Apple ReplayKit 做本地录制与直播。
在 iOS 目标上调用 ReplayKit 开始/停止录屏或广播。
仅 iOS 有意义；需相应系统权限。
en_steps: Enable `ReplayKit for iOS` (module `IOSReplayKit`).
It supports local recording and broadcasting via Apple ReplayKit.
On iOS targets, start/stop ReplayKit capture or broadcast from game code.
Meaningful on iOS only; requires the matching system permissions.
note_cn: iOS 上用 ReplayKit 本地录屏/直播。
note_en: Local recording and broadcasting on iOS via ReplayKit.

cn_steps: 启用 `Replication Graph`（模块 `ReplicationGraph`）。
它用图结构维护持久的复制 Actor 列表，作为面向大量 Actor 与连接的 Replication Driver。
在 `DefaultEngine.ini` 里把 Replication Driver 换成 ReplicationGraph，并按玩法划分节点/空间网格。
大型联机项目常用；替代默认的简单复制驱动。
en_steps: Enable `Replication Graph` (module `ReplicationGraph`).
It is a Replication Driver that keeps persistent replicated-actor lists in a graph, designed for many actors and connections.
Switch the Replication Driver to ReplicationGraph in `DefaultEngine.ini` and partition nodes/spatial grids for your game.
Common in large net games; replaces the default simple replication driver.
note_cn: 面向大量 Actor/连接的图结构复制驱动。
note_en: Graph-structured replication driver for many actors/connections.

cn_steps: 启用 `Replication System Test Plugin`（模块 `ReplicationSystemTestPlugin`）。
它提供网络复制系统的单元测试与功能测试。
跑这些测试来校验复制系统行为，而不是当游戏功能。
属测试插件；不要当 Shipping 玩法。
en_steps: Enable `Replication System Test Plugin` (module `ReplicationSystemTestPlugin`).
It provides unit and functional tests for the network replication system.
Run these tests to validate replication behavior; they are not a gameplay feature.
It is a test plugin; do not ship it as gameplay.
note_cn: 网络复制系统的单元/功能测试。
note_en: Unit and functional tests for the network replication system.

cn_steps: 启用 `Resonance Audio`（运行时 `ResonanceAudio`，编辑器 `ResonanceAudioEditor`）。
它是 Google 的 3D 音频空间化与室内声学模拟插件。
在项目设置里把空间化插件选为 Resonance Audio，给音源配置房间/遮挡。
Game 模块依赖运行时模块；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Resonance Audio` (runtime `ResonanceAudio`, editor `ResonanceAudioEditor`).
It is Google's 3D audio spatialization and room-acoustics simulation plugin.
Select Resonance Audio as the spatialization plugin in project settings and configure rooms/occlusion on sources.
Game modules depend on runtime modules; editor modules are Editor-target only.
note_cn: Google 的 3D 空间化与室内声学插件。

cn_steps: 启用 `RewindDebuggerToolset`（模块 `RewindDebuggerToolset`、`RewindDebuggerToolsetTests`）。
它提供只读的 Rewind Debugger 记录检查工具（给 AI 助手/自动化）。
通过工具集注册表查看回放记录，而不是当 Shipping 游戏功能。
属 Toolset；测试模块只进测试 Target。
en_steps: Enable `RewindDebuggerToolset` (modules `RewindDebuggerToolset`, `RewindDebuggerToolsetTests`).
It provides read-only Rewind Debugger recording inspection tools (for the AI assistant/automation).
Inspect rewind recordings via the Toolset Registry; not a shipping gameplay feature.
It is a Toolset; test modules go to test targets only.
note_cn: 只读检查 Rewind Debugger 记录的 AI 工具集。
note_en: Read-only AI toolset to inspect Rewind Debugger recordings.

cn_steps: 启用 `RHI Tests`（模块 `RHITests`）。
它是渲染硬件接口 (RHI) 的自动化测试。
跑这些测试来校验 RHI 后端（资源创建、绘制、同步）。
属测试插件；一般只进测试/Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `RHI Tests` (module `RHITests`).
It is automation tests for the Rendering Hardware Interface (RHI).
Run these tests to validate RHI backends (resource creation, draws, sync).
It is a test plugin; typically Editor/test targets only.
note_cn: 渲染硬件接口 (RHI) 的自动化测试。
note_en: Automation tests for the Rendering Hardware Interface (RHI).

cn_steps: 启用 `Rider Integration`（模块 `RiderSourceCodeAccess`）。
它允许从编辑器访问/打开 Rider 中的源代码。
在编辑器源码访问设置里选 Rider，双击 C++ 类即可跳到 Rider。
属编辑器开发者插件；默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Rider Integration` (module `RiderSourceCodeAccess`).
It allows accessing/opening source code in Rider from the editor.
Choose Rider in editor source-code access settings, then double-click a C++ class to jump to Rider.
It is an editor/developer plugin; it does not ship by default.
note_cn: 从编辑器跳转到 Rider 打开源代码。
note_en: Open source code in Rider from the Unreal Editor.
